contract_yaml:
# Data contract shared by the publisher and the dashboard: source tables, keys, time rules, notification thresholds,
# published fields and the rules of the results.
schema_version: 1

source:
  timezone: Europe/Rome
  locale: en-GB

tables:
  station_info:
    key: VisitID
    required: [VisitID, StationID, Date, Start, End, Num_fisher, EventID, UpdatedAt]
  catchdata:
    key: CatchID
    link: VisitID
    required: [CatchID, VisitID, Fisherman, Species, Length, Weight, CandR, UpdatedAt]
    derived_from_event: [Date, StationID, EventID]
  station_registry:
    key: StationID
    required: [StationID, Lat, Lon]

historical_prefixes: [VHIST_, HIST_]

automation:
  light_check_minutes: 1
  full_reconcile_hours: 24
  light_summary_minutes: 60
  folder_name: reel4science-automation-test

# Explicit whitelist: only these source columns and the declared derived fields leave the Sheet; free-text notes
# are excluded.
publication:
  paths:
    latest: data/latest.json
    status: data/status.json
  heartbeat_minutes: 60
  notification_retention_hours: 24
  analytics_version: 5
  formats:
    date: [Date]
    time: [Start, End]
  tables:
    station_info:
      fields: [VisitID, EventID, StationID, Area, Date, Start, End, LATstart, LONstart, LATend, LONend, Num_fisher, DepthStart, DepthEnd, Temp, Salinity, Tidal_Phase, Tidal_Height, Sea, Weather, Goal]
      derived: [start_at, end_at, trip_state]
    catchdata:
      fields: [CatchID, VisitID, EventID, Date, StationID, Fisherman, FishingGear, Species, Length, Weight, NPTF, CandR]
      derived: []
    station_registry:
      fields: [StationID, Area, Lat, Lon]
      derived: []

# Results computed by the publisher: summaries, prizes, leaderboards, length-weight fits.
analytics:
  no_fish_species: NO_FISH
  # CandR, compared without case: Y from history and TRUE from AppSheet are recorded releases,
  # N and FALSE are not, empty is unknown; any other value is unknown and raises a private warning
  released_values: ['Y', 'TRUE']
  not_released_values: ['N', 'FALSE']
  fishers:
    # identity publishes the names as entered;
    # alias publishes only the names listed in aliases, every other name becomes unknown
    mode: identity
    aliases: {}
    # compared trimmed and without case; unknown fishers are excluded from prizes and leaderboards
    unknown_values: ['', 'unknown', 'unknown fisher', 'na', 'n/a']
  top_n: 10
  # Prizes and their leaderboard orders: only fishers with at least min_fish fish are ranked.
  # Biodiversity: highest Simpson diversity 1 - D (D = sum of squared species shares) of the fisher's catch;
  # Conservation: highest share of fish released, equal shares go to more releases
  prizes:
    min_fish: 5
  lw:
    min_pairs: 3
    confidence_level: 0.95
    grid_points: 100
    # Length measured in the app: TL (total) or FL (fork); references must use the same type
    measured_length_type: TL
    # Literature references drawn as a grey curve W = a * L^b; W in g, L in cm. One entry per species;
    # required: a, b, length_type, citation; optional (checked when present): length_range [min, max] cm (without it
    # the curve covers the observed lengths), url (https), retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD). No entry: no reference line.
    references:
      Cod:
        a: 0.0058
        b: 3.14
        length_type: TL
        citation: FishBase
        url: https://fishbase.se/summary/Gadus-morhua.html
      Saithe:
        a: 0.0074
        b: 3.05
        length_type: TL
        citation: FishBase
        url: https://fishbase.se/summary/Pollachius-virens.html
      Ling:
        a: 0.0036
        b: 3.10
        length_type: TL
        citation: FishBase
        url: https://fishbase.se/summary/Molva-molva.html
      Halibut:
        a: 0.00437
        b: 3.21
        length_type: TL
        citation: FishBase
        url: https://fishbase.se/summary/Hippoglossus-hippoglossus.html
      Brosme:
        a: 0.0112
        b: 2.98
        length_type: TL
        citation: FishBase
        url: https://fishbase.se/summary/Brosme-brosme.html

notifications:
  sync_max_minutes: 5
  detect_max_minutes: 5
  start_max_minutes: 30
  end_max_minutes: 30
  clock_skew_tolerance_minutes: 5

profile_columns:
  station_info: [Date, Start, End, UpdatedAt, Num_fisher]
  catchdata: [CandR, Species, Length, Weight, UpdatedAt]
